Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread or misinterpreted Stewart Raffill’s birth year from the Wikipedia page, stating 1932 instead of the correct 1942. This led to an incorrect comparison (1932 vs. 1939) and the wrong conclusion that Lost in Africa’s director was born earlier. The accurate comparison (Bertrand Blier, 1939 vs. Stewart Raffill, 1942) shows Buffet Froid’s director was born earlier.
